title: Cathedral of St. Peter and Paul, Brno
visualBrief: Individual Brno Petrov cathedral: broad higher western nave and lower polygonal east choir, twin square stone towers beside their junction, open Gothic belfry/crowns and very slender green-gray metal needle spires. Smaller choir ridge fleche, metal roofs with small nave dormers, warm mixed rubble stone/pale trim, tall pointed glazing, stepped buttresses, west gabled facade and open outer portal with closed wood entry behind it. Low northern chapels and southern vestry follow approximate clips within mapped envelope. Shared materials, standard-terrain foundations. Exact sculpture/inscriptions, tiny latticework, stained-glass art, bells/interiors, surrounding town/landscaping and certified walking excluded.

Medium-fi exterior based on four useful pictures and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM only. Eaves/roof slopes, tower subdivisions/crowns, small annex clipping, porch dimensions, dormers, facade rhythm, buttress widths and thresholds are estimates. Exact sculpture/inscriptions, stained-glass art, bells/interiors, Petrov terrace retaining walls, surrounding town/landscaping and certified walking excluded. Physical device timing pending.

Skyline keeps twin needle spires at the junction, broad high nave, lower choir, fleche, open porch and coarse buttresses. District adds textures, flat glazing/doors, clocks/dormers and open belfries/crowns. Street adds recesses, stepped buttresses/pinnacles, portal bands and sparse tracery. Closeup/master refine facets. Synthetic context neighbors are not mapped Brno buildings.
importReason: Four authored browser levels retain the central-junction twin spires, broad nave, lower polygonal choir, small fleche and western Gothic portal at the signed mapped site.
